say:1:1430216101:1.text: This servant's master is a useless lord who survives in the royal city by relying on his reputation and title alone. Attending his banquet would only dishonor me!
say:1:1430216101:1.source_cn: 这仆从的主人不过是靠着余荫和头衔在王城苟活的废物罢了，...
say:1:1430216101:1.male: This servant's master is a useless lord who survives in the royal city by relying on his reputation and title alone. Attending his banquet would only dishonor me!
say:1:1430216101:1.female: This servant's master is a useless lord who survives in the royal city by relying on his reputation and title alone. Attending his banquet would only dishonor me!

say:2:1430216102:1.text: Don't waste your breath trying to persuade. I will not attend.
say:2:1430216102:1.source_cn: 不必劝说了，我是不会去的！
say:2:1430216102:1.male: Don't waste your breath trying to persuade. I will not attend.
say:2:1430216102:1.female: Don't waste your breath trying to persuade. I will not attend.
